SELECT cls, boat,
  SUM(yt) as yt, SUM(anglers) as anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),4) as rate,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  MAX(fished_date_doy) as last_doy
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 2 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 130 AND 152 AND cls IN ('three_quarter','hd_am','hd_pm','full_day')
GROUP BY cls, boat
HAVING SUM(anglers) > 0
ORDER BY rate DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season=2
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 8

SELECT boat, cls, fish_date_doy
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls='three_quarter' AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 153 AND 166
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
LIMIT 60

SELECT fished_date_season as season,
  (fished_date_doy/10)::int*10 as bucket,
  SUM(yt) as yt, SUM(anglers) as anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),4) as rate,
  COUNT(*) as trips
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','three_quarter','full_day') AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 150 AND 310
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT boat, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),4) rate, COUNT(*) trips, MAX(fished_date_doy) last_doy
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=2 AND cls='three_quarter' AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 145 AND 152
GROUP BY boat ORDER BY rate DESC

SELECT fished_date_season as season, cls,
  (fished_date_doy/10)::int*10 as bucket,
  SUM(yt) as yt, SUM(anglers) as anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),4) as rate,
  COUNT(*) as trips
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=1 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 270 AND 310
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 3,2
